standard.title: VELOCITY SCALE SET FOR METEOROLOGICAL PURPOSES
standard.sector: Meteorological Instruments Sectional Committee, BP 21 / Basic and Production Engineering Division Council
standard.description: This standard covers the general and functional requirements of rigid velocity scale sets used for determining the wind speed from the plotted hodograph of the pilot balloon ascents for meteorological purposes.
standard.scope: This standard covers the general and functional requirements of rigid velocity scale sets used for determining the wind speed from the plotted hodograph of the pilot balloon ascents for meteorological purposes.

certification.description: Conformity assessment and licensing are supported by the Bureau of Indian Standards Certification Marking scheme, with compliance systems administered directly by BIS.
requirements: The velocity set scale shall consist of either 3-scales or a square with its four edges suitably graduated. For 3-scale sets, each individual scale is utilized for different portions of the plotted balloon ascent hodograph based on specific scale factors.

The first velocity interval of 10 m/s must be marked such that the 10 m/s mark is positioned on the left and the 0 (zero) m/s mark is on the right. Subsequent graduations are provided at every 5 m/s interval.
Plastic scales must have smooth, even sides and be completely free from blisters, porosity, and structural defects. They must exhibit uniform width and thickness throughout their entire length.
Metal scales must be manufactured completely free from seams, flaws, scales, burrs, and other physical defects, maintaining a uniform thickness and width throughout.
The edges of both plastic and metal scales must not deviate from a straight line by more than 0.5 mm at any point. Similarly, their plane surfaces must not vary from a flat plane by more than 0.5 mm.
